entries.2a78543d0852fe5f: An AI-OCR service that makes handwriting recognition AI based on deep learning usable by anyone in daily work, and which the securities report names as its main product. "Intelligent OCR," which digitizes and sorts forms, and "Elastic Sorter," which sorts multiple types of forms scanned in random order into the same types, can be contracted in combination. Revenue consists of monthly usage-based fees based on the number of reads and monthly fixed fees for optional features (recurring model), and initial fees and others (selling model); initial fees are apportioned over the service provision period and recorded as revenue. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, the number of usage licenses that the company and its sales partners provided to their respective customers was 3,203 (3,057 in the same period of the previous year). In May 2025, it began providing an AI agent as a standard feature to all users. No figure for this business alone is given.

entries.be88b9ccd69aee13: An AI platform premised on LLMs (large language models), integrating the technologies and services provided so far, such as "AnyData" and "Heylix." Companies can create and operate AI agents using their own business knowledge and various data. It can take in data such as PDFs and images for search and generation processing, and AI agents can be created with natural-language instructions or embedded into existing systems through an API. It can also be used to offer the AI created to outside parties and create new revenue opportunities. An early access (EA) version began to be offered in July 2025, and official provision began in May 2026. No figure for this business alone is given.
entries.bff4dcf23002859d: In April 2025, it renewed the product lineup of "AI inside Cube," hardware for edge computing, to 5 products. In May, it installed AI agents as standard in "DX Suite" and began providing them to all users; in June it updated "PolySphere-2" to "PolySphere-3," and in October it updated "PolySphere-3" to "PolySphere-4." In July, it was selected for the third phase of the "Development of Competitive Generative AI Foundation Models (GENIAC)" publicly solicited by NEDO, and it also began providing the EA version of "Leapnet," a platform that creates new revenue sources with AI.
